about: Verified team-name equivalences used to join Hotspawn fixtures to outside prices, Valve standings and HLTV. Only names proven to denote the same team in the same fixture slot are listed. Generic words (Team, Esports, Gaming, GG) and case/punctuation are normalised in code, so 'Team Falcons' = 'Falcons' needs no entry. Session arena/22be6967, read 2026-10-15 10:05-10:25 UTC.
